name: Mahou Shoujo Asuka
source: Evil magical girl serving Nemesis. She reverts to her form when her magical power was at its peak. Transforms into a squid-shaped creature, her motif is a squid + angel. While Hikaru's Octova has only the soft hairs of tentacles wrapped around her, Asuka always keeps the tentacles inserted into her vagina. Her power increases with heightened sexual arousal, which she controls at a high level. Despite being a first-generation Injel, she can match the power of Hikaru, who uses the second-generation Octova. Has personality of an innocent girl who does terrible things with a kind smile.
